blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The civilian and Church-led Truth Commission has documented 8,320 killings linked to former President Rodrigo Duterte’s drug war, exceeding the 6,252 deaths reported by the Philippine National Police. Nearly a decade after the killings began in 2016, the Philippines still lacks a definitive, universally accepted tally of deaths linked to the campaign
